zh: 侧栏搜索固定在“新会话”下方，并改为与其一致的无边框行按钮：左侧圆形搜索图标，右侧“搜索会话”文案；不再使用输入框描边或快捷键键帽。Ctrl+K 与 Search palette 保持不变，折叠侧栏仍显示可访问的搜索图标。
en: Sidebar Search stays below New Session and now matches its borderless action-row style: a circular search icon on the left and a Search sessions label on the right, without an outlined field or shortcut keycaps. Ctrl+K and the palette remain unchanged, and the collapsed rail keeps an accessible search icon.
